prompt: The upload page feels kind of plain, make it feel more premium.
assertions: Headings continue to use the Outfit/display font class and body copy the Plus Jakarta Sans/root font class, not swapped or mixed arbitrarily

Existing shared primitives (Field, PrimaryButton, StepPill, etc.) are reused rather than reimplemented inline
